resolved_findings: Rollback holds the original checked inode and lock, rechecks bytes/path identity and active configuration, preserves substituted paths, and verifies restoration before reload.

Old and candidate configurations are compared in equal adaptation contexts; actual mounted-path adaptations and full active JSON preserve every original route and setting.
Staging cleanup verifies absence; incomplete or uncertain activation retains its private diagnostic state.
An interrupted installer is treated as potentially mutating: exact old/candidate states are verified, while partial/unknown states require manual recovery and retain staging.
reviewed_safeguards: Exact credential-name whitelist; private files are staged separately from image/source and no values are printed by the activation plan.
Fresh supplemental ledger has a distinct authorization; existing state/source and Compose-project collisions refuse overwrite.
Pinned image and all 34 runtime asset hashes are checked; archive metadata contains no unsafe paths or link members.
No new proxy interface, host application port, instance or plan; actual container resource/security settings are checked.
Activation creates no case, payment or model request; public TLS and the provider journey remain explicitly unverified until later checks.
